pages.text: Build a $(l:basics/portal)rune portal$() and step into a $(item)Sanctum$(): a dungeon floating in the void, generated just for you and up to 2 friends.$(br2)Your goal: dig up a $(l:raid/eggs)rare egg$(), loot the chests and get back out alive.
The Sanctum has a $(l:raid/raid)timer$(). When it hits zero, the Sanctum collapses: $(bad)everyone still inside dies$() and loses what they carried.$(br2)Manage your time, and remember to head back.
pages.title: Watch out!
